verdict.rationale: Vendor explicitly advertises debugging/troubleshooting via natural language (gh-3) and @gemini-cli on-demand debugging assistance (gh-12/21), backed by large-context codebase navigation praise (comm-1). But hands-on reports concretely contradict reliability: users report it gets stuck in error/agentic loops and fails basic function calls (comm-10, comm-11), one case where it caused catastrophic data loss during a troubleshooting session (comm-16), and others calling it 'useless as a coding assistant' that gets stuck in spaghetti code (comm-14, comm-15). missing for 10: independent benchmark of debugging accuracy, resolution of the reliability complaints, consistent hands-on success stories outweighing failures.
